name: Marmorica - CAR Deck
notes: Floor plan dimensions are estimates, not a survey.
Wall and floor thicknesses are proposed at 0.15 m. Materials and lighting are a preview treatment.

Car-deck detail profile v1: saved footprints, openings, anchor centres and cameras are retained. Ramp ribs, door frames, steelwork, colours and lighting are proposed design detail, not surveyed construction.
Lane spacing and repeated beams/lamp fittings are proposed within the saved deck. Wall signs sit on the inner face of the proposed 0.15 m bulkhead. Other grouped dressing remains simplified.
